title: spec migration: page-slots-tabs-retired replacement still says a kind 'full' page is "drawn as authored" everywhere; #36180 qualified the twin remedy text
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Companion to #36180 (PR #36197). Raised, ungraded, by the seat's schema-face contract review on PR #36197 (record 7070380222).

## The gap

`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.page-slots-tabs-retired.ts` ends its `replacement` with: a page that needs its own strip "is a `kind: 'full'` page whose regions carry the header, the highlights, the `page:tabs` strip and the discussion, drawn as authored."

Since #36150 (PR #36174) an assigned record page of kind `full`, `html` or `react` is drawn as authored on the desktop full page only; on a phone (under 768 px) and in the preview the standard page replaces it. PR #36197 qualified the twin text, `PAGE_SLOTS_TABS_REMEDY` in `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`, and the `PageSchema.kind` describe. This migration entry, which `os migrate` and the migration docs show to authors, still reads as "everywhere".

## What to do

1. Qualify the sentence the same way the remedy now reads (desktop full page only; the standard page on a phone and in the preview).
2. Regenerate whatever reference page embeds the migration text, and check any pin on the replacement string.
3. Changeset at the level ruling A gives a describe-only spec change (`Metadata-protocol: semantic` reading as on #36197).

Size XS. Contract face (`packages/spec/src/**`): L1 plus the seat's Fable schema-face L2.
